glossary.title: POM glossary
glossary.description: Review the English and Simplified Chinese terms that shape every TechPack export. Preview changes before they reach the factory floor.

launcher.title: POM translation glossary
launcher.description: See which English–Chinese terms are live, preview spreadsheet changes, and restore an earlier version.

scope.title: Glossary scope
scope.description: Choose where these translations should win.
scope.brandHelp: The backend verifies this key against an active TechPack configuration for your company.
scope.brandRequiredDescription: A configured brand key is required before this scope can be loaded.

entries.title: Live translation ledger
entries.description: The winning term for this scope, including the layer it came from.
entries.emptyDescription: Try another search or scope. This glossary may currently inherit every term from another layer.

upload.title: Preview a spreadsheet
upload.description: Uploading creates a reviewable preview. Nothing changes until you explicitly apply it.
upload.dropDescription: One .xlsx file, up to 5 MB. Use the template if you need the expected columns.
upload.previewPromise: Previewing never writes to the live glossary.
upload.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit.

preview.title: Review glossary changes
preview.description: Nothing is live yet. Check every addition, translation change, and removal before applying this file.
preview.notFoundDescription: This preview does not exist, has expired, or is not available to your company.

diff.removedHelp: These terms are absent from the file and will fall back to a broader layer.
diff.truncated: Only the first 500 rows are shown. The count above includes every affected term.
diff.noChangesDescription: This file produces an empty diff for the selected scope.

history.title: Upload history
history.description: Applied, superseded, and rejected files for the selected scope.
history.emptyDescription: Completed and rejected uploads will appear here.

confirm.title: Apply this glossary?
confirm.description: The file will become the complete glossary for this scope.
confirm.removalDescription: They are not deleted, but will fall back to the next available glossary layer.

stale.title: The glossary changed after this preview
stale.description: Start over and upload the file again so you can review a fresh diff.

toast.appliedDescription: Future TechPack exports will use the new terms for this scope.
toast.revertDescription: Review the diff, then apply it through the normal confirmation step.

unavailable.title: Glossary is unavailable
unavailable.description: POM Chinese translation is not enabled for this company, or you do not have access to this workspace.
